stagingAccess.safeFailure: no deployment, log read, authenticated smoke, or evidence promotion attempted

blockers.requiredEvidence: A staging product request must execute federated retrieval through at least two exact lawful production-eligible supplier identities with provenance, bounded failure, and no silent substitution.
blockers.missingEvidence: Only recorded adapters and a development-only SearXNG composition exist; public Nominatim is non-resale, Common Crawl is legal-review gated, and no live supplier is product-connected or staging-executed.

blockers.requiredEvidence: A staging search trace must bind the accepted query to the bounded deterministic rewrite variants consumed by live retrieval.
blockers.missingEvidence: Repository tests pass, but no deployed live-provider trace proves rewrite propagation.

blockers.requiredEvidence: A staging trace must show two independent qualified retrieval paths start within the same bounded execution window and degrade independently.
blockers.missingEvidence: Parallelism is proven only with recorded adapters; no qualified live paths are wired or deployed.

blockers.requiredEvidence: Staging output must demonstrate canonical URL normalization and exact/near-duplicate accounting over live provider results.
blockers.missingEvidence: Deterministic repository fixtures pass; no live staging corpus/output evidence exists.

blockers.requiredEvidence: Staging results must expose source-bound freshness, authority, relevance, and diversity components over live observations.
blockers.missingEvidence: Ranking is repository-verified only and has no calibrated live staging evidence.

blockers.requiredEvidence: A concrete disposable browser process must execute in staging behind the N4.13 preflight/network boundary with isolation, byte, request, deadline, and cancellation receipts.
blockers.missingEvidence: N4.25 adds the exact-attested worker and isolation manifests but deliberately keeps zero replicas and unavailable health because no pinned image, gateway, container/browser runtime, or staging execution exists.

blockers.requiredEvidence: Staging security runs must prove robots, timeout, size, redirect, MIME, public-DNS, rebinding, and SSRF enforcement against the deployed retrieval path.
blockers.missingEvidence: N4.25 expands deterministic repository proof through crawl-delay, concurrency, compression and cancellation, but no deployed live retrieval security transcript exists.

blockers.requiredEvidence: A staging live-content test must prove instruction-like source text remains quoted untrusted evidence and cannot invoke tools or actions.
blockers.missingEvidence: Recorded repository fixtures pass; no live-content staging execution exists.

blockers.requiredEvidence: A staging response must bind every cited claim to exact extracted text offsets, source identity, retrieval timestamp, and content hash.
blockers.missingEvidence: Citation binding is repository-only because live provider-to-fetch execution is absent.

blockers.requiredEvidence: Staging must demonstrate miss, fresh hit, and stale revalidation against a durable environment-separated cache with truthful age and lifetime disclosure.
blockers.missingEvidence: N4.25 adds environment-separated filesystem/PostgreSQL durable adapters and local stale/poisoning/eviction proof; no staging PostgreSQL cache execution or revalidation transcript exists.

blockers.requiredEvidence: Staging live suppliers must receive and truthfully honor or reject supported language and region values without substitution.
blockers.missingEvidence: Request propagation is repository-tested, but no live provider honoring evidence exists.

blockers.requiredEvidence: Deployed staging discovery, challenges, execution, and receipts must preserve distinct search.web and search.answer prices and price versions.
blockers.missingEvidence: Prices are published locally, but the deployed paid route is non-payable and discovery says payment is unimplemented.

blockers.requiredEvidence: A repeatable staging benchmark must use live qualified paths and record quality, citation validity, p50/p95 latency, provider cost, and failure behavior.
blockers.missingEvidence: Only a deterministic synthetic recorded benchmark exists; no live calibrated staging run exists.

blockers.requiredEvidence: Two independently operated, production-eligible retrieval paths must execute through the product in staging with exact identities and isolated degradation.
blockers.missingEvidence: The broker and archive mechanics are development-only; Nominatim cannot be resold, Common Crawl needs legal review, and neither path is product-connected.

blockers.requiredEvidence: The deployed staging release must serve responses and discovery matching the checked-in strict schemas with release-bound hashes.
blockers.missingEvidence: Generated schemas pass locally, but the deployed release predates N4.21 and exposes only the recorded implementation.

blockers.requiredEvidence: The deployed staging path must reject tampered live citations and accept exact source-bound citations.
blockers.missingEvidence: Adversarial repository tests pass; no staging verifier run over live retrieval exists.

blockers.requiredEvidence: A staging suite must exercise private/metadata targets, DNS rebinding, redirects, MIME/size limits, cancellation, and browser network containment without escaping the service boundary.
blockers.missingEvidence: N4.25 adversarial local tests and an exact-attested adapter pass; no digest-pinned browser runtime, gateway, or authenticated staging security run exists.

blockers.requiredEvidence: A calibrated staging benchmark must materially beat the named compatible baseline on quality/citation/freshness while remaining within latency and cost ceilings.
blockers.missingEvidence: Only a synthetic recorded corpus beats the baseline; no live supplier comparison exists.

blockers.requiredEvidence: The staging paid route must publish a payable x402 challenge, verify authorization, execute only after verification, settle or safely reconcile, receipt once, and replay without a second charge.
blockers.missingEvidence: The deployed route intentionally returns a non-payable challenge with executionAllowed=false; no facilitator/payee authorization or real payment implementation is available.

blockers.requiredEvidence: Staging must deliver bounded provider/product metrics, dashboards or queryable collector evidence, and at least one safe alert through an approved channel.
blockers.missingEvidence: Only process-local snapshots and Cloud Run request logs exist; no snapshot collector, dashboard, paging delivery, or alert-channel credential is available.

blockers.requiredEvidence: A staging live-provider drill must prove request, provider-cost, concurrency, timeout, circuit, and kill-switch ceilings stop external traffic without charging an unverified result.
blockers.missingEvidence: Atomic reservations pass locally, but no live provider spend cap or staging traffic-stop drill exists.

campaignQueue.goal: Bind the exact blocker matrix, TypeScript conclusion, staging-access preflight, dependency order, and external stop decision.
Approve and qualify two production/resale-eligible independent retrieval paths and provide authenticated access to the existing staging control plane.

Wire both exact local routes through query rewriting, parallel fetch, normalization, ranking, locale, provenance, citations, schema validation, and safe degradation while preserving missing staging traces.
Repository-harden the exact-attested isolated browser boundary, durable environment-separated cache, retrieval safety, and adversarial suite while preserving unavailable staging proof.
Run calibrated live staging benchmarks and prove monitoring delivery, provider budgets, cost caps, circuits, and kill switches.
Implement and deploy the payable x402 route with authorized facilitator/payee configuration, safe reconciliation, receipts, and replay proof.
Re-run every source-bound staging check, require zero blockers, authorize the reference pattern only on a truthful pass, synchronize, and stop before Stage 5.

ownerIntervention: Activate an authorized gcloud identity or mount approved application-default credentials with Cloud Run, Cloud Build, Artifact Registry, and log read/deploy access for bloxsniper-prod/us-central1 without requiring Codex to change IAM.

Provide the approved provider credential environment-variable names and mounted values after supplier selection; no provider credential is currently present.

Authorize staging facilitator/payee configuration and any separate bounded real-settlement proof needed for deployed_paid_route; the current campaign prohibits wallet/facilitator transactions and USDC spend.
Provide an approved staging alert-delivery channel and its credential environment-variable name if Cloud Logging alone is insufficient for the monitoring gate.

Provide separate N4.27 payment authority covering mock or testnet commerce configuration and any expressly permitted facilitator, payee, payer, settlement, receipt and replay proof; N4.26 authorizes none of those actions.
